title: Mechanisms of Fecal Incontinence in Wolfram Syndrome
official: Physiopathogenic Mechanisms of Fecal Incontinence in Wolfram Syndrome
summary: In order to clarify the mechanism of fecal incontinence in in Wolfram syndrome and to characterize its risk factors, the examiner will reviewed the files of patients followed in a Reference Center for Rare Diseases in Ophthalmology.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Wolfram syndrome

Exclusion Criteria:

* no information concerning fecal incontinence in data records
